title: Remove `AppSidebar` from `@object-ui/app-shell` once the deprecation window closes (follow-up to #5720)
body:
Follow-up to #5720, which censused `AppSidebar`'s consumers before deciding delete-vs-deprecate and landed on **deprecate**.

## Census summary (full detail in #5720 and the linked PR)

- **No in-repo mount point.** `ConsoleLayout` renders `UnifiedSidebar`, not `AppSidebar`; `git grep` outside `AppSidebar.tsx`, its own tests, and prose finds no import anywhere in `apps/**` or `examples/**`. `content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md` already documents this.
- **No downstream GitHub-visible consumer found**, searched via `search_code` across `org:objectstack-ai` for both `AppSidebar` and `"@object-ui/app-shell"`. The only cross-repo hits naming `AppSidebar` specifically are a spec liveness-audit citation and an example app's source comment — neither is an import.
- **It IS a genuinely published export**: present in the package barrel, in the built `packages/app-shell/dist/index.d.ts`, and `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `package.json` sets `publishConfig.access: "public"` with an active `registry.npmjs.org` publish step in `.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml`. That means real npm consumers outside this GitHub org are possible and are **structurally invisible to this census** — this is the "external consumers" branch of the triage disposition, so the correct move is deprecate-then-remove, not delete-now.

## What this issue is

Once the deprecation (added in #5720's PR — `@deprecated` JSDoc on `AppSidebar` pointing at `UnifiedSidebar`) has had a reasonable window to surface any real external adopter (via downstream bug reports, npm download signal, or another census), do the removal:

- [ ] Delete `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSidebar.tsx` and its test files (`packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppSidebar.*.test.tsx`, `appSidebarSettingsTargets.test.tsx`, plus the `AppSidebar` halves of `systemNavDatasourcesHop.test.tsx` / `systemNavObjectsHop.test.tsx` / `systemNavSettingsTarget.test.tsx` — those three cover both components in one file).
- [ ] Remove the barrel export in `packages/app-shell/src/layout/index.ts` and `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`.
- [ ] Update the two stale cross-references: the `<AppSidebar />` usage example in `ExpressionProvider.tsx`'s JSDoc, and the `AppContent.tsx` comment naming "AppSidebar's own add-app entry".
- [ ] Re-run the same census (in-repo grep + org code search + built `.d.ts` check) immediately before removal, in case a consumer showed up in the interim.
- [ ] Changeset stating the removal in migration terms (`minor`, per this repo's fixed-group convention — see AGENTS.md "版本号策略").

## Not in scope here

The gating divergence #5720 recorded (`AppSidebar` gates only `sys-marketplace` on the workspace-admin flag; `UnifiedSidebar` gates the whole admin cluster) is not being reconciled — the component is going away, not being kept in parity. Noted in the `@deprecated` tag as a reason not to treat the two as interchangeable during the deprecation window.

Refs: #5720
